label: 2023 Men's South American Volleyball Championship - 35th edition
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-4 (PLAN-VB + CENSUS-VB-4), Director-approved 6-edition batch commit. Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); official match count == built count; FIDELITY per-team pool points recomputed == printed standings spw/spl (deviations, if any, proven arithmetically and disclosed); spine/table-top asserts exact. 35th edition, Recife, 26-30 Aug 2023, single round-robin of 5 (10 matches). HISTORY: champions ARGENTINA - SECOND TITLE IN THE EVENT'S 72 YEARS AND FIRST SINCE 1964, ending Brazil's run of every championship they entered - clinched by beating hosts Brazil 3-0 (25-19 29-27 25-22) on the final day (MVP Vicentin, best setter De Cecco); ARG+BRA+COL qualified for WCh-2025 (in store). FIDELITY CATCH #3 OF THE WO: the printed standings are internally consistent BUT disagree with the match row on the final's set 2 - printed totals imply 27-25 while the match row and its live.app.fivb.com report say 29-27; per-match-source precedence keeps 29-27, expected standings recomputed (ARG 324/243, BRA 294/232 vs printed 322/241, 292/230) and the discrepancy is documented both ways for auditors. Sources: official FIVB Live Center match pages (unique ids 17580-17589).
